evals.prompt: Write a JavaScript function that takes a list of ISRCs and returns only the tracks with BPM between 120 and 140 using the MeloData API
evals.expected_output: A function that calls batch/features, filters by bpm range, handles auth and errors
expectations: Includes Authorization header with Bearer token
Filters results by bpm >= 120 and bpm <= 140
Handles the case where features may be null (not_found tracks)

evals.prompt: I need a Python script that gets audio features for a song, and if the API returns 202, retries until it gets the data
evals.expected_output: Python function with retry logic for 202 status, using Retry-After header
expectations: Reads Retry-After header for wait time
Implements retry loop or recursive call
Uses the correct MeloData API URL format with ISRC

evals.prompt: Build a music recommendation feature that finds tracks similar to 3 seed songs, preferring high-energy danceable tracks
evals.expected_output: Code using the recommendations endpoint with seed ISRCs and target_energy/target_danceability params
expectations: Sets target_energy and target_danceability query params
Handles the response format with match_score
